bible.logline: Advanced quantum computing silicon processor hardware fabrication sequence inside an ultra-sterile cleanroom. Precision CNC robotic arm positions a monolithic semiconductor chip wafer beneath laser etching beams, revealing intricate nanoscale circuit pathways, gold wire bonds, and an anodized aluminum cryo-chamber enclosure.

pm_recommendations.title: SMPTE 12M Timecode Sync, Digital Clapper Slate & ASC-MHL Offload Manifest Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Production sound mixers, script supervisors, and DIT offload technicians for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require standardized SMPTE 12M linear/drop-frame timecode synchronization (HH:MM:SS:FF / HH:MM:SS;FF), production clapper slates (Scene/Take/Roll/Filter/FPS), and American Society of Cinematographers Media Hash List (ASC-MHL v2.0 XML) cryptographically sealed offload manifests (MD5, SHA-1, C4) to guarantee picture-to-sound synchronization and dual-destination archival data integrity.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement Smpte12MTimecodeSpec, ClapperSlateSpec, AscMhlHashEntry, AscMhlManifestSpec, and MasterProductionSlateSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.clapper_slate (SMPTE 12M frame conversion, drop-frame alignment, audio sync offset calculation, ASC-MHL v2.0 XML generator, clapper slate CSV log, Avid ALE sound sync log export), CRAFT clapper slate prompt tokens ([CLAPPER_SLATE: ...]), prompt auditor slate verification rules, and an interactive Digital Clapper Slate Console with clapper arm animation in the dark-room animatic.
